fixed: Cancelling an update download no longer appears stuck for up to a minute when Windows is still holding the partly downloaded file open (for example while antivirus scans it). Cancel now takes effect within a few seconds and you can start the download again.
changed: On Windows and Linux, the app now deletes update downloads that are over a week old from your system's temporary folder each time it starts, so installers from earlier updates no longer pile up there.
